The '''Fondor Shipyards''', also known as the '''Starship Yards of Fondor''' and as the '''Fondor Construction Yards''', were massive [[Starship/Legends|starship]] construction facilities orbiting the planet [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. Operated by the [[Fondor Guild of Starshipwrights]], the Fondor shipyards were among the three largest ship manufacturers in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], producing both civilian and military vessels. The Starship Yards of Fondor had served all galactic governments throughout the millennia of their existence. The yards were nationalized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by it regained its independence years later as the '''Fondor Independent Shipyards'''. The Fondor Shipyards were ravaged by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] but later rebuilt by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

==Description==
The Starship Yards of Fondor [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] and necklaced the planet [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], a world located in the [[Freeworlds Territory|Freeworlds]] portion of [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Fondor_EotECR.png|thumb|left|220px|Fondor, with its shipyards visible from space]]
The Fondor Shipyards were among the oldest, largest and most sophisticated shipyards in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> The shipyards of Fondor were the third [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-building place in the galaxy after the [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array|Kuat shipyards]] and the [[CEC shipyards|Corellian shipyards]]. Rather than emphasizing on mass-production, the Fondor Shipyards were renowned for their high-quality production. The [[Fondor Guild of Starshipwrights]], that ruled both the planet and the shipyards, exercised tight control over every step of ship production to maintain its high quality standard.<ref name="EotECR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

The shipyards of Fondor had a varying layout, including large and various space stations and construction devices.<ref name="DVS" /> The shipyards were operated by thousands of orbital workers who performed their tasks wearing [[Environment suit/Legends|g-suit]].<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> The ship-building facilities supplied by the rich mineral resources extracted in a nearby asteroid belt.<ref name="Revelation" /> Materials were also provided by neighboring worlds such as [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]]<ref name="SW98" /> and [[Gandeal]].<ref name="TCSWE-Gandeal">{{CSWECite|I|320|Gandeal}}</ref> Millennia of starship construction had left the planet surrounded by a ring of debris that made space travel in the area very complicated.<ref name="EotECR" />

==History==
===Old Republic===
{{Quote|A Mandalorian clan attacked and hijacked our warship "Allusis" while it was undergoing refit at the Fondor shipyards. They're using the vessel to raid defenseless Outer Rim systems.|[[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="TOR:IFMR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|[INTRO] Flashpoint: Mandalorian Raiders|Carrick Station}}</ref>}}
The Fondor Shipyards were major [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] shipyards during the [[Old Sith Wars]]. However, the [[Assassinations in the Nyssa system|emergence]] of a [[Mecrosa Order|Sith cult]] in the Tapani sector led the sector, including Fondor and its shipyards, to join [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]'s [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and, decades later, [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Galactic Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Varad]] hijacked the Republic battle cruiser ''[[Allusis]]'' while it was undergoing refit at the Fondor Shipyards.<ref name="TOR:IFMR" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Groodo the Hutt, a starship manufacturer from Esseles, attempted to ruin the starship yards of Fondor. I must surmise his motive was to gain Fondor's lost business. Groodo's scheme was foiled by the Jedi, but he has so far managed to elude their suspicion.|Darth Tyranus, to Darth Sidious|<ref name="THP">''[[Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess]]''</ref>}}
The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|mission to Fondor]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] foiled a scheme by [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to destroy the Fondor Shipyards using a [[False Sun Runner|counterfeit]] ''[[Sun Runner]]'' [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. Before the drifting derelict could collide with the shipyards, an 18-year-old [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was able to destroy it through a combination of planting a [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenade]] to the vessel's [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter reactor]] and demolishing its sensor-[[Guided missile/Legends|guided missile]] silo with the [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion-missile]] [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|launcher]] of a borrowed [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]]—the shock waves of these explosions, however, forced Skywalker to crash-land on the Fondor [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nallastia]].<ref name="HtSR" />

At the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Fondor Guild of Starshipwrights was a minor member of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] but much guild members did not support the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]] so the shipyards contributed marginally to the Separatist war effort.<ref name="TEA" /> Fondor and its shipyards remained affiliated with the Republic during the conflict. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the Clone Wars, a small Republic/[[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] taskforce [[Skirmish at the Fondor Shipyards|battled]] and captured [[Dool Pundar]]'s [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|battleship]], the [[Profit (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|''Profit'']], in the shipyards of Fondor.<ref name="TCW:SA" />

===Imperialization===
{{Quote|The Fondor system is currently the site of a massive Imperial construction project and has been closed to all civilian traffic, according to a member of the Corellian Merchant's Guild who asked not to be named. A military blockade surrounds the Fondor shipyards, with orders to destroy trespassers.|[[Independent Traders' Infonet/Legends|Independent Traders' Infonet]]|<ref name="GNN5">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalized]] the Fondor shipyards around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TEA" /> Although the [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] shipyards were the primary manufacturers of Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], Fondor was unexpectedly chosen to build the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], the fist vessel in a [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|new line]] of gigantic warships. The Empire enforced total secrecy for this project and closed the entire star system to all non-military traffic. The Fondor executives were outraged as they consequently lost all their clients and on-going contracts.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> The Guild of Starshipwrights nonetheless complied and was allowed to remain in power to oversee the construction of the ''Executor''.<ref name="TEA" /> In fact, the gargantuan project took up nearly all the resources of the shipyards.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> To support the project, the Empire blazed a [[Gandeal-Fondor Hyperlane|secret hyperlane]] to connect Fondor with the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] at Gandeal, a checkpoint for [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]] transporting raw marerials.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:ExecutorFondor-CSW.png|thumb|280px|[[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] under construction at the Fondor Shipyards]]
In addition to the infuriated Fondorians,<ref name="TEA" /> the ''Executor'' project also irritated numerous [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] officers. As the ship was intended to become [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], they considered the project was a huge waste of resources that could be used by the Navy rather than creating a new toy for Vader. In the months following the Battle of Yavin, a group of [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]] plotted against Darth Vader and decided to permit the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to sabotage the ''Executor''.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] accepted to [[Mission to Fondor (Galactic Civil War)|travel]] to the Fondor Shipyards to meet the Imperial officers. However, one of them, Admiral [[Amise Griff|Griff]], had remained loyal to Vader and eventually betrayed the Rebel hero and the traitorous officers. The officers were arrested but Skywalker managed to escape in extremis.<ref name="DVS" />

Six months after the Battle of Yavin, the construction of the ''Executor'' reached completion. Darth Vader traveled to the Fondor shipyards to take command of his new flagship and used it against the Rebels [[Yavin blockade|blockaded]] at [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Trap">"[[It's a Trap]]"</ref> The Fondorian Starshipwrights expected that this success would allow them to obtain lucrative Imperial military project grants from their rival, [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> However, to their anger, Kuat Drive Yards ended up gaining all rights to future models of Super Star Destroyers.<ref name="TEA" />

Despite this setback, the Empire somehow allowed Fondor to develop an ''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought [[Unidentified Executor-class Star Dreadnought|variant]] possessing cloaking capabilities. A giant shield was enveloped requiring at least 18 shield stations to maintain, and the destruction or otherwise disabling of one would result in the shield collapsing. In addition, the shipyards were also guarded by a complement of Imperial [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commandos]] as well as several [[Imperial escort carrier (storm commando)|Imperial escort carriers]]. Nevertheless, the Rebel Alliance, learning of this development. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] made an [[Fondor shipyard assault|attack against the orbital shipyards]] in year [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], which resulted in the destruction of the vessel before it was ever completed. In actuality, the Empire, under the Emperor's orders, deliberately leaked the intel of the ship's construction to the Rebel Alliance to grant them a victory as to ensure that they grow overconfident enough to be drawn into a trap.<ref name="RS3" />

Overall, the Fondor shipyards were [[Sorties against Fondor Shipyards|raided]] by the Rebels twelve times prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CCG" />

===New Republic===
[[File:Rebel_Fondor.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Alliance of Free Planets|Alliance]] ships undergo maintenance at the Yards shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].]]

After the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the Battle of Endor, the Empire began to collapse and the Rebel Alliance was reorganized in the [[Alliance of Free Planets]].<ref name="TEA" /> In the weeks following the Battle of Endor,<ref name="SW98" /> Fondor was seized by the Alliance of Free Planets, with the complicity of the Guild of Starshipwrights.<ref name="TEA" /> The shipyards were renamed the Fondor Independent Shipyards,<ref name="VEaA">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040304vandelhelm|text=Vandelhelm: Enemies and Alloys|int=Vandelhelm: Enemies and Alloys}}</ref> and were used by the Alliance of Free Planets. Prior to the [[Nagai–Tof War]], Generals [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] commanded the Alliance fleet stationed at the Starship Yards of Fondor. While there, Han Solo solved the yards supply problem by [[Mission to Vandelhelm|escorting]] the two [[Venerated Ones]] of [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]] to their home planet and securing an alliance with the [[Metalsmiths Guild]] of Vandelhelm.<ref name="SW98" />

In the next years, the Fondor Shipyards became a major New Republic shipyard.<ref name="TEA" /> Part of the yards were converted to the construction and repair of civilian transports while the rest was dedicated to construction of New Republic warships designed by the [[Republic Engineering Corporation]].<ref name="TNJOS">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref> The shipyards remained a major New Republic shipyard during the rest of the Galactic Civil War, in particular during the [[Hunt for Zsinj]] and the [[Thrawn campaign]],<ref name="TEA" /> but suffered damages during the final stages of the war.<ref name="TNJOS" />

[[File:BattleofFondor.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Warships on both sides are destroyed by [[Centerpoint Station]] during the [[Battle of Fondor]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].]]
The Fondor Shipyards were still a crucial New Republic shipyard during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and thus a target for the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Having been deceived by the Vong, the New Republic was caught fatally off guard by the [[Battle of Fondor|attack at Fondor]]. [[Orbital Shipyard 1321]], one of the orbiting shipyards, was rammed by several Yuuzhan Vong coralskippers during the battle, and destroyed. Eventually, many Republic vessels were lost, most vaporized by an overly hasty firing of [[Centerpoint Station]].<ref name="AoC2" /> After the battle, the shipyards were largely in ruins.<ref name="TNJOS" /> Later in the war, the New Republic, now the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], [[Battle at Fondor|retook control]] of Fondor. General [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] immediately began repair work of the shipyards but he did not expected the facilities to produce any ship before months.<ref name="TFP">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref> The Fondor shipyards were eventually rebuilt by the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="TCSWE-Fondor">{{CSWECite|I|284|Fondor}}</ref>

===Second Galactic Civil War===
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Fondor seceded from the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and allied with the [[Confederation]].<ref name="Exile" /> The Fondor Shipyards became the first provider of warship of the Confederation, and therefore a major threat for the Alliance.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Fondor and its shipyards were soon targeted by Galactic Alliance's [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of States]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Cha Niathal]], supported by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] of [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. During the [[Second Battle of Fondor|battle]], one of the docks repelled a GA boarding party. Others sustained heavy fire from Imperial and Galactic Alliance ships. It was revealed that the Fondorians had hidden large numbers of ships in the docks by making it appear that the ships were under construction. Eventually, the attempt to take the planet, including the yards and other assets, intact, failed, causing Solo to order the bombing of [[Oridin City|Oridin]], a major Fondorian city, with the result being Cha Niatha [[Alliance-in-exile|splitting]] her forces from the GA and the assassination of Gilad Pellaeon.<ref name="Revelation" />
